record: Heavy Metal: F.A.K.K.2's map sidecars: an audio zone file and a static light file for each official map
dirtyTreeNote: Generated in the shared working tree, over uncommitted work by several sessions, including the Alice sidecar pipeline this extends.

installation.root: .tmp/fakk2-install/game (laid down from the user's retail disc; see the contracts record)

surfaceFlags.source: Ritual's F.A.K.K.2 v1.02 SDK fgame/surfaceflags.h (reference observation only), checked against the thirty retail maps' compiled shader records
surfaceFlags.againstAlice: the same bits as alice.exe's surfaceparm table (0x005294d0) but for Alice's `slide` (0x2000000), which F.A.K.K.2 lacks; neither has Quake III's skip

entityLightLump.source: the SDK's qcommon/qfiles.h mapspherel_t (reference observation only)
entityLightLump.note: Alice's 60-byte record adds a trailing `cap`; F.A.K.K.2's has none

entityLightPower.rule: |intensity| * 7500 / d^2 a light, no cap, a light under 1 left out; the sum times 1 << (r_mapOverBrightBits - tr.overbrightBits), 4 at the defaults: |intensity| * 30000 / d^2, alice.exe's

perLight.code: 0x0048dd80: |I| times the constant and Q_rsqrt(d^2) squared (0x0043c0b0) at 0x0048ded6, a power under 1.0 (0x004d53e8) skipped; the spot path (0x0048d990, 0x0048db75), the per-vertex path (0x0048e5d4) and the dynamic lights (0x0048f283) multiply by the same constant

sumScale.code: 0x0048e090: each of the six summed directions times 1 << (r_mapOverBrightBits - tr.overbrightBits), then scaled down to 255 at most
sumScale.r_mapOverBrightBits: registered '2' (0x00460edb; the cvar pointer is stored at 0x00460eee)
sumScale.tr.overbrightBits: 0x00cdc600, set from r_overBrightBits (registered '0', 0x00460d7c) by 0x0046ff70, and 0 without gamma or fullscreen

entityLightPower.models: the dispatcher 0x0048e170 takes the per-light path for a model whose renderfx has 0x200 or 0x8000000 (0x0048e182; Ritual's SDK q_shared.h names them RF_EXTRALIGHT and RF_INVISIBLE, read for reference only) and another path otherwise
entityLightPower.againstAlice: alice.exe's per-light code (0x004ab850) multiplies by 30000 (0x005004a0, at 0x004ab9a6) and clamps to the record's cap (0x004ab9c9); its last step (0x004abb80) shifts by tr.overbrightBits alone, 0 at its defaults: the same 30000
entityLightPower.source: fakk2.exe 1.02 from the official 1.02 patch (SHA-256 681bc51c3343d01d772c5ae4aae7523ae4547350b243c875156e138043335785; the disc's fakk2.exe is encrypted), read statically with capstone; the sum's factor was found by the model-lighting work (2026-09-25-ritual-model-lights.md)

staticLights.rules: the Alice generator's exclusions, radius, colour, cone and cluster-spread selection (generate_stock_alice_lights.py), with no light capped, and its colour balance for the renderers' per-pixel pass (balance_colors: the eight strongest contributions at a light's origin add at most SUPPLEMENT_PEAK 0.5, each other light counted at its unbalanced colour)

lawCheck.finding: fakk2.exe's model light at its defaults is alice.exe's |I| * 30000 / d^2 (7500 a light, times 4 for the sum), so the radii these files carry were already its law's

regenerated.generator: the F.A.K.K.2 generator stating the law, over the unchanged Alice rules

balanceWithPublishedColours.note: at each light's origin, the eight strongest contributions with every light at its published colour and default reach

halfRadiusExperiment.what: the same lights at half the radius (7500 without the sum's factor), generated and measured, not shipped

fakkhouse-glx-lightlaw.command: scripts/probe_ritual_client.py --profile fakk2 --renderer glx --map fakkhouse --sound --extra r_staticLightDebug=1, steps .tmp/fakk2-light-law/runtime/steps.cfg, on each runtime
